svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from 6 mm PVC foam board: base 510 x 560; two sides 510 x 238;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two ends 548 x 238. Ends fit between the sides; all stand on the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outdoor end: two 160 x 180 openings centred 185 left and right,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from 24 to 204 up from its bottom edge; a 14 hole 40 left, 16 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Room end: a 220 x 190 opening from 30 to 250 left, 24 to 214 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes 6 and 12 at 150 and 170 right, 199 up (light and button).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right side: a 12 hole 50 from the room end, 194 up (power gland).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base: four 5.5 holes, 140 and 440 from the outdoor edge, 175 each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Battens 10 x 10: four uprights 238; two 478 under the sides; two 528

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the ends. Glue every joint with PVC cement and screw each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: board into the batten behind it, 3.5 x 16 screws at 80 centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: square within 1 mm on the diagonals; openings line up with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the collar and grille positions on the other sketches.
